roleLabel: Combo Warrior — auto-attack punches that self-Shield from damage dealt
bestFor: Rush / Attack Speed Warrior boards that want a self-sufficient melee carry
strength: Triple Threat counts as autos, builds lasting Shields from damage, and itemizes cleanly into Attack and Rush
weakness: Needs hits to land; if she is kited or stunned through the combo she gets neither damage nor Shields

howToPlay.early: She can front-mid early if packs are melee-heavy. Buy Attack and a bit of survivability; do not expect Mage-level clear from one cast alone.
howToPlay.mid: Champion = Rush stacking for Warriors. Brawler = bigger Shields and Attack from Shields. Boxer = AS Burn on autos. Align relics to that choice.
howToPlay.late: Rush engines and Bloodshield/Aegis pieces keep the loop alive. Keep her attacking — idle Reyna is a dead card.
howToPlay.positioning: Front-mid on the pack she can actually punch. Do not hide her in the back; the combo wants contact.

abilityNotes.Triple Threat: Each punch is an auto — Attack Speed and on-hit effects matter. Shields equal damage dealt, so damage relics also buy survivability.

specNotes.The Champion: Team Rush Warrior buff path. Take when you run multiple Warriors and can trigger Rush often.
specNotes.The Brawler: Selfish Shield carry — more Shields from Triple Threat and Attack from Shields. Best solo Reyna path.
specNotes.The Boxer: Burn on-hit path. Take with Attack Speed and long fights; weaker in short burst matchups.

relicReasons.warriors-bloodshield-engine-4000: Shield damage loop mirrors how Triple Threat already self-Shields.
relicReasons.warriors-bravery-banner-510: Warrior aggression banner for the carry fantasy.
relicReasons.martial-amplifier-2015: Clean Attack/martial glue when class relics are scarce.

faq.question: Is Reyna good in Guildrun?
faq.answer: Strong melee carry when she can stay in contact. Weak if your board is all ranged and she never throws the combo.

faq.question: What class is Reyna?
faq.answer: Warrior. Role focus: combo melee who converts punch damage into lasting Shields.

faq.question: What relics work with Reyna?
faq.answer: Warrior Bloodshield / Bravery banners, martial amplifiers, and Rush pieces if you took Champion.

faq.question: How do you play Reyna?
faq.answer: Put her on the fight, stack Attack (and AS for Boxer), cast Triple Threat, and pick Brawler for solo carry or Champion for Warrior tribal.

tips: If she dies mid-combo, buy survivability or fix placement before more Attack.
Champion without other Warriors wastes the Backup team buff — prefer Brawler then.
